key_randomization: random.Random(world_seed), independently shuffle L then S then W ID arrays; no source-dependent key selection
paragraph_unit: maximal contiguous UDante annotation citation run; noncontiguously repeated citation labels receive occurrence suffixes and are never merged or silently corrected
normalization: casefold; expand ae/oe ligatures; NFKD; remove combining marks; preserve ordered alphabetic words; reject whole control paragraph if any alphabetic word retains a non-ASCII Latin letter; ignore punctuation and spacing as unscored channels
public_observation: typed L/S/W primitive IDs with exact normalized word and paragraph boundaries
truth_policy: maps, plaintext and annotation-based evaluation tags remain in sealed/ until evaluator access is authorized; deterministic source-independent seeds provide procedural blinding, not cryptographic secrecy
